Dave Matthews Band

The Cynthia Woods Mitchell Pavilion 
The Woodlands, TX

Taper:		Justin Kacz
Source:		DPA 4018v + DPA 4028 > Sound Devices MixPre-6ii
Location:	back of the pit, stage left
Conversion:	Adobe Audition 2024 > CD Wave Editor v1.98 to .flac, level 8
Mixing:		4018v L/R channels boosted the highs, mixed a single 4028 channel to center and cut the lows below 175Hz, normalize and limit, fade in/outs
